scope: Partial independent momentum diagnostics on fixed full saved coefficients. Normalized volume holdouts, distinct from the training norm. No full Tier gate and no exact Euler solution claim.
coefficient_policy: exact full exchange coefficients, no projection, refitting, phase alignment or rescaling
arithmetic: U, DU, source evaluation and source projection are binary64. Stable linear evaluation and reconstruction of pressure from those binary64 source coefficients use long double (63 explicit mantissa bits). More accurate reconstruction does not bound the source or quadrature error.

prerequisites.scope: Only leading_subtraction=True power and logarithmic branches. The raw logarithmic control failed and is not used by this holdout.

tail_treatment: On final interval [T,infinity), s=T/t: subtract the main-main leading power/log source, integrate it analytically, and quadrature the full-source remainder including B/D/E and subleading main terms. No enclosure is claimed for this quadrature remainder.
remaining_full_validation: at least256 extended-precision far points per checkpoint
